name: Vrat (Fasting) Reference
note: Per-planet traditional fasting day and method. Fasting practices vary meaningfully by region and lineage; this records the most commonly cited day/method per planet rather than any single authoritative rule. Same non-prescriptive framing as gemstones.json/mantras.json - and, unlike gemstones, this specific remedy carries real health considerations (existing conditions, medication, pregnancy) that a general astrology reference cannot account for.

verification_pass.method: Per-planet correspondences cross-checked against multiple classical/reference sources for consistency - these are widely standardized associations across Vedic astrology texts with little cross-source disagreement, unlike e.g. Pitra Dosha's definition.

user_review_pass.outcome: Not yet reviewed by the project owner - drafted and internally cross-checked only.

items.method: A single meal before sunset, traditionally without salt; some observe a full day's fast, breaking it at sunset facing the sun.
items.title: Vrat for Sun
items.summary: Traditional Sunday fasting associated with Sun.
items.effects: Fasting on Sunday is traditionally undertaken to strengthen Sun's themes through self-discipline. A single meal before sunset, traditionally without salt; some observe a full day's fast, breaking it at sunset facing the sun.
